name: print-social-navy-creative-marketing-agency-post-with-angled-photo-window
title: Navy 'Creative Marketing Agency' post with an angled photo window and white outline echo
whatItIs: A square white post with a navy gradient wedge on the left holding a thin-and-bold 'Creative MARKETING AGENCY' headline and contact rows with icons, a photo of a smiling man at a desk in an angled rounded window, a thin white outline echoing the window, and small triangle outlines.
whatItMeans: Dynamic and sharp; angled shapes add motion to a standard corporate layout.
techniques: Crop the photo in an angled rounded window.
Echo the window with an offset outline.
Put contact rows with icons in the text panel.

vocabulary.definition: A thin stroke shifted from a shape's edge.
